output.review_comment: The changes introduce inconsistent logic where function behavior (inclusive vs exclusive end point) depends on whether holidays fall on weekends. This is test-specific logic rather than a coherent fix. The semantic change of starting at `start + ONE_DAY` instead of `start`, combined with conditional end_condition logic, needs justification. Please: (1) explain what the actual spec is based on the test cases, (2) rewrite this with consistent, logical semantics that don't change based on holiday placement, and (3) add a PR description explaining the fix.
